meta.title: Survey Form Block: customer NPS survey
meta.description: A published page with the plugin's Customer Satisfaction & NPS survey. Answer it, then open Survey Forms > Survey List to see the response and its Summary.
meta.author: bplugins

steps.code:
<?php
require_once '/wordpress/wp-load.php';
wp_set_current_user( 1 );
kses_remove_filters();
$attrs = BPSVB_Patterns::getTemplateAttributes( 'csat-nps' );
$attrs['form']['id'] = 'svb-playground-nps';
wp_insert_post( [
	'post_type'    => 'page',
	'post_status'  => 'publish',
	'post_name'    => 'customer-feedback',
	'post_title'   => 'Customer feedback',
	'post_content' => wp_slash( '<!-- wp:svb/survey-block ' . serialize_block_attributes( $attrs ) . ' /-->' ),
] );
